adapterChoices.status: Customer-specific API/connector and transaction behavior must be implemented
Optional; validate SAP version, supported API/connector, gateway requirements, authentication and commit semantics
Optional; implement the same contract for a supported customer ERP

capabilityGate: Do not enable automatic registration until the selected adapter proves unique-reference behavior, reliable outcome lookup and permission enforcement

failureClasses.BUSINESS_REJECTION: Do not retry without correcting and revalidating the business case
failureClasses.TRANSIENT_BEFORE_COMMIT: Retry only if the adapter can prove no commit and reuse the same reference
failureClasses.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Persist unknown state and reconcile; never blind retry
failureClasses.AUTH_CONFIGURATION: Alert integration owner; retries alone will not fix credentials
failureClasses.THROTTLED: Respect Retry-After and adapter-specific concurrency, preserving idempotency

invariants: No create/post tool is exposed directly to the model
Unresolved human-review cases block new posting; reviewer release still requires fresh preflight and valid approval
External reference is unique per posting intent and customer/entity
Same external reference with a different payload is a conflict
NOT_FOUND is not proof of noncommit with an eventually consistent API
ERP draft creation, posting, accounting and payment are separate capabilities
Posted documents are corrected using ERP-approved credit/reversal procedures, not deletion
If the ERP cannot enforce uniqueness or authoritative lookup, disable autonomous posting
